# galaxy-profile

This folder is an unmodified copy of the `generator` package from
[vinimlo/galaxy-profile](https://github.com/vinimlo/galaxy-profile), commit
`ca7706590fe6f3f012b3e63e4ff5d101380f60b2`, under the GPL-3.0 licence in `LICENSE`.
The fonts are Spectral and Noto Serif, under the SIL Open Font Licence in `assets/fonts/`.

To update it, copy a newer `generator` folder over this one and run the build again.
